title: Question 9
passage:
Should this label printer stay on the packing table?
A. No, it belongs on the shelf under the table. B. There's a fresh roll of labels in the drawer. C. That table was delivered on Friday.
passageZh:
這台標籤印表機要留在包裝桌上嗎？
A. 不用。它應該放在桌子下方的架子上。
B. 抽屜裡有一卷新的標籤紙。
C. 那張桌子是星期五送到的。
